en: Prompt engineering is the process or the art
of sending good prompts to AI models. Now,
this used to be more important in the early
days of large language models because they
were less capable back then.
Nowadays, even pretty vague prompts can get
you good results, but
nonetheless,
taking the time to craft good prompts and to
make sure that you clearly specify your
task, your constraints, your output,
expectations,
potential definitions, maybe a writing style
that should be used by the model.
Taking the time to clearly define all these
things still can and will lead to better
results. And it can save you extra round
trips and these extra follow-up questions
where you wonder if the model really is that
dumb.
No, it's not. You just have to
write good prompts. And clearly specify what
you want. So prompt engineering, the art of
writing good prompts, still matters, and
it's in the end simply about efficiently
describing what you want,
just as you should do if you're talking to a
fellow human.
